nodes.summary: Algebras over commutative rings: étale algebras and the trace form, norm and trace maps, Kähler differentials and derivations.
nodes.title: Étale algebras, norms and differentials

nodes.summary: Dedekind domains and their characterizations, unique factorization of fractional ideals into primes, the ideal class group, invertible fractional ideals and the conductor of an order.
nodes.title: Dedekind domains and ideal theory

nodes.summary: Rings of formal power series in one or several variables and Hahn series, with formal exponentials, derivatives, coefficient operators and Lagrange inversion.
nodes.title: Formal power series

nodes.summary: Ideals and submodules under localization, Hilbert's Nullstellensatz, zero divisors, products of rings and fields, and ring constructions such as Witt vectors.
nodes.title: Ideals, localization and ring constructions

nodes.summary: Rings of invariants of finite groups acting on commutative rings: finiteness of invariant rings and Hilbert–Poincaré series of modular invariant rings of polynomial algebras.
nodes.title: Invariant theory

nodes.summary: Local rings and their residue fields, Krull dimension, adic completion, regular local rings and length of modules.
nodes.title: Local rings, dimension and completion

nodes.summary: Projective, free and finitely generated modules over commutative rings and module-finite extensions: Kaplansky's theorem, the Quillen–Suslin theorem, descent of Noetherianness (Eakin–Nagata) and the direct summand theorem.
nodes.title: Modules over commutative rings

nodes.summary: How primes split, ramify and stay inert in finite extensions of Dedekind domains and discrete valuation rings, measured by the different, the discriminant, ramification indices, inertia degrees and Frobenius elements.
nodes.title: Ramification theory

nodes.summary: Free resolutions of modules over polynomial rings, Hilbert's syzygy theorem, and graded Betti numbers and Poincaré series of multigraded modules.
nodes.title: Syzygies and free resolutions

nodes.summary: Discrete valuation rings and general valuation rings, their completions and finite extensions, residue fields, Hensel's lemma and the Krull–Akizuki theorem.
nodes.title: Valuation rings and Henselian rings

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
